summary.zh: 教务、在线教学、体育场馆与网费
summary.en: Academics, LMS, sports venues, and campus network

description.zh: 一个命令覆盖中大常用服务：教务（课表/成绩/考试/请假）、在线教学平台（课程/作业/课件下载）、体育场馆（空位查询/预约/取消）与网费（服务状态/订单/续费）。账号密码只在插件页使用，首次打开自动安装 CLI。
description.en: One CLI for daily SYSU services: academics (timetable, grades, exams, leave), LMS (courses, assignments, file downloads), sports venues (availability, booking, cancellation), and campus network fees (status, orders, renewal). Credentials stay on the plugin page; the CLI installs on first use.
